column1: # purrdf-sparql-governors profile v6 — normative vector manifest.
# Columns: case <TAB> data <TAB> query <TAB> source <TAB> governors <TAB> band <TAB> outcome
#              http wires the injected transport described in transport.tsv;
#              relation wires the scripted property function described in relations.tsv;
#              aggregate wires the registered custom aggregate from governor_corpus.rs's
#              `registered_custom_aggregate` (no sidecar table — it is deterministic by
#              construction, so nothing about a run needs to be counted and pinned beyond
#              what every other lane's `.answer`/`.spend`/`.metered` already record)
#   governors  comma-separated <setting>=<value>; a ceiling names a caller-settable
#              deadline; and "stop" names a signal (cancelled, cancellation,
#   band       zero       the ceiling is 0 and admits no charged work
#              boundary   the ceiling IS the metered cost, so the run MUST complete
#              over-bound the ceiling is the metered cost minus one, so the run MUST trip
# Band ceilings and outcomes are DERIVED, never authored: they are written by the
# corpus regeneration step from a QueryGovernors::METERED run of the same case, and
# the harness re-derives and re-checks them on every ordinary run.
